hplc.title: HPLC (High-Performance Liquid Chromatography)
hplc.definition: The primary analytical chemistry technique used to separate, identify, and quantify each component in a mixture. At 99 Purity Wholesale, we use HPLC to verify that our research compounds exceed the ≥99% purity threshold.

lyophilized.title: Lyophilized
lyophilized.definition: The process of freeze-drying a compound to remove water while preserving its chemical structure. This results in a stable, powdered form that is ideal for long-term storage and transport without requiring a constant cold chain.

glp1-agonist.title: GLP-1 Agonist
glp1-agonist.definition: Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 receptor agonists are a class of research compounds that mimic the GLP-1 hormone. In research settings, these are studied for their effects on glucose metabolism, insulin secretion, and appetite regulation.

secretagogue.title: Secretagogue
secretagogue.definition: A substance that promotes secretion. In peptide research, growth hormone secretagogues (GHS) like Ipamorelin or CJC-1295 are studied for their ability to stimulate the pituitary gland to release endogenous growth hormone.

moq.title: MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity)
moq.definition: The smallest amount of a product that a wholesale supplier is willing to sell. For 99 Purity Wholesale, our MOQ is typically 10 units (1 kit), which allows us to maintain competitive wholesale pricing for professional clients.

coa.title: COA (Certificate of Analysis)
coa.definition: A document issued by an analytical laboratory that confirms a product meets its quality specifications. Our COAs include HPLC and Mass Spectrometry data to prove purity and identity.

dac.title: DAC (Drug Affinity Complex)
dac.definition: A technology used to increase the half-life of a peptide by allowing it to bind to albumin in the bloodstream. CJC-1295 with DAC has a significantly longer duration of action in research models compared to CJC-1295 without DAC.

no-dac.title: No-DAC (CJC-1295 without DAC / Mod GRF 1-29)
no-dac.definition: The version of CJC-1295 that does not include the Drug Affinity Complex. It has a shorter half-life and is often preferred in research where precise control over growth hormone pulses is required.

spps.title: SPPS (Solid-Phase Peptide Synthesis)
spps.definition: The standard method for chemical peptide synthesis. It involves building a peptide chain by adding amino acids one by one while the chain is tethered to a solid support. This method is used in our U.S. facility for high-purity production.

research-grade.title: Research Grade
research-grade.definition: A specification indicating that a compound is intended exclusively for laboratory research and is not for human or animal consumption. Our research-grade peptides are produced to the highest analytical standards (≥99%).

hgh.title: HGH (Human Growth Hormone)
hgh.definition: A hormone produced by the pituitary gland that stimulates growth, cell reproduction, and cell regeneration. Many peptides in our catalog are studied for their role as HGH secretagogues.

peptide-api.title: Peptide API (Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient)
peptide-api.definition: The pure peptide compound used as the active component in research formulations. We supply bulk APIs to compounding pharmacies and researchers.

purity-threshold.title: Purity Threshold
purity-threshold.definition: The minimum acceptable percentage of the target compound in a batch. 99 Purity Wholesale enforces a strict ≥99% threshold, verified by third-party analysis.

cas-number.title: CAS Number
cas-number.definition: A unique numerical identifier assigned by the Chemical Abstracts Service to every chemical substance. It ensures unambiguous identification of research compounds in scientific literature and procurement.
